 Kyle Kennedy, RFK’s granddaughter dies at 42 — years after suffering tragic spinal cord injury 
 By 
 Ronny Reyes 
 Published 
 Oct. 20, 2026, 11:07 a.m. ET 
 See more of our coverage in your search results. 
 Make New York Post a Preferred Source 
 Kyle Kennedy, the granddaughter of Robert and Ethel Kennedy, died at 42.
 Kennedy died on Sep. 21 at her home in Westwood, Massachusetts — six years after she suffered long-term paralysis from a spinal cord injury.
 Her cause of death remains unknown.
 Kyle Kennedy Kerr speaks onstage during the 2019 Robert F. Kennedy Human Rights Ripple Of Hope Awards in New York City, Wednesday, Dec. 12, 2018. Getty Images for Robert F. Kennedy Human Rights 
 Robert F. Kennedy and his wife Ethel Skakel leave a church following their wedding in Greenwich, Connecticut, June 17, 1950. Bettmann Archive
